referenceTool.name: reference_read
referenceTool.description: Reads Tsugumi's bundled references (read only): demos/ (working example projects), sdk/python/tsugumi/__init__.py (the Python Card SDK) and card-guide.md. A folder lists its entries.

delegateTool.name: delegate
delegateTool.description: Hands independent parts of the work to helper Agents that work at the same time in this project, one per task, with the same tools; returns each helper's report once all have finished. Each task owns the root-level Cards it lists: its helper changes only their definitions (never tsugumi.json, the layout or another Card), and a Card belongs to one task only.

name.description: a short name for the helper, e.g. its Card's id

cards.description: ids of the root-level Cards this helper owns

instruction.description: what to do, how to check it and what to report

helper.outside: The helper {name} may change only its own Cards ({cards}); this save also changes {what}. Nothing was saved: change only your Cards.
helper.invalid: delegate needs 2 to 8 tasks, each with a name, an instruction and root-level Cards of this project that no other task lists: {why}

showTool.name: guide_show
showTool.description: The bird flies to a part of the screen and speaks there: it points at it (highlight), says one line beside it (say), and offers choices the user can tap as their reply and buttons that act. Nothing happens until the user presses a button; the app then does it with its own controls.

highlight.description: where the bird flies and what it points at: run (the run / stop button), chat (the Agent chat button), logs (the log button), demos (Home's demo list button), new_project (Home's new project button), settings, card:<Card id> (a Card of the workflow on the screen) or demo:<demo id> (its card in Home's demo list, which opens)

say.description: what the bird says in its speech bubble: one to three short sentences, the point of this step (your reply text is the full explanation)

choices.description: short replies the user can tap in the bubble (e.g. 次へ, もっと詳しく); the one tapped comes back to you as the user's message

endTour.description: true at the last step of a demo tour (the next steps offered): the tour is over and the app stops telling you about runs

label.description: the button's text: a few words in the user's language

card.description: open_card: the Card's id (its settings window opens)

guide.shown: Shown. Nothing has happened yet: the user decides whether to press a button.
guide.readOnly: {tool} is not one of the guide's tools: the guide only reads. Offer the user a button with guide_show or tell them how to do it.
guide.noProject: No project is open on the user's screen, so there is no project to read.
guide.tourStart: [Tour] The user chose to see the demo "{demo}" ({title}). An editable copy is open (the bundled original is untouched). Begin the tour at step 1.
guide.tourResume: [Tour] The user is back in the demo "{demo}". Continue the tour from where it was (look at the last run first).
guide.disconnected: The connection to the project's environment was lost; the run's outcome is unknown until it comes back.
guide.reconnected: The connection to the project's environment is back; the run's state is {state}.

permissionDeclined: The user did not approve what this save gives Cards: {permissions}. Nothing was saved. Do not retry it; tell the user what the Card needs and why, and leave the setting to them.
